question: Does the original source prescribe a sector extension, defect fusion or Calderon action that realises the statistics transport exp(2 pi i v.s) = -1, and how does it act on a fermionic and a bosonic generator including time?
summary_de: KORRIGIERT 15.10.: Halbstring D = S^2 am unveraenderten QWZ-Zylinder (v988:75-96) ist eine Eichverlagerung: D H_r D unitaer aequivalent zu H_r, Schleifenholonomie bleibt i^r (Naht i^{r+2}, Bindung a->a+1 traegt -1 = R); kein Sektorwechsel r->r+2. H3 war nur das Vorzeichen von Gamma, keine D8-Monodromieidentitaet (v/s-Befund vorbestehend). Viertelversion samt Z4-Register vorbestehend in v1033. S=exp(i pi N_arc/2): [Q_ges,S]=0, gerade, Ad S erhaelt CAR; [dGamma(H_r),S] = Einkoerper-Schnittstrom an beiden Bogenenden, keine skalare Frequenz; S ist nicht der E_lambda-Erzeuger.
assumptions: Unchanged v988 QWZ cylinder as the source representative
Half string as in half-twist-grade-carry section 4
not_derived: Bulk-corrected half string with charge carry U_s and cocycle as a finite-energy field
Calderon operator formula for the sector change
Identification of the QWZ representative with the P1 raw kernel
